# [BRAND]

> A Kubernetes operator that runs Apache Kafka 4.x (KRaft mode) across 3+ Kubernetes clusters with one shared controller quorum, via any Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Services (MCS) implementation — Submariner Lighthouse, Cilium Cluster Mesh, Istio multi-cluster. Ships the full platform — Kroxylicious proxy with OIDC RBAC, Apicurio Schema Registry with a JWT-aware RBAC proxy, MirrorMaker2 with schema-ID rewriting, declarative backup/restore, Cruise Control rebalancing, and a Kafka UI — as eleven first-class CRDs. Apache 2.0.

## What it is

[BRAND] is a Kubernetes operator. It replaces the assembly of {Strimzi + Keycloak + Apicurio + MM2 + Cruise Control + a UI + backup glue} with a single operator that manages all of those as CRDs of one product.

## Who it's for

- Platform engineers running Kafka on Kubernetes across more than one cluster.
- SREs who need multi-region or multi-cloud HA without DR cutover scripts.
- Security/governance teams that need OIDC, JWT-claim-based ACLs, and per-artifact schema-registry RBAC out of the box.

## Eleven CRDs (kafka.yavari.afshin.se/v1alpha1)

- `KafkaCluster` — cluster-wide config; `clusters[]` lists each Kubernetes cluster the quorum spans.
- `KafkaNodePool` — controller or broker pool; supports mixed roles.
- `KafkaTopic` — declarative topic management via primary-cluster AdminClient (mTLS).
- `KafkaProxy` — Kroxylicious deployment with custom filters (JWT/OIDC, RBAC, schema and XML validation).
- `KafkaRbac` — topic-level + schema-registry ACLs in one CR; groups, users, quotas.
- `ApicurioRegistry` — Apicurio Schema Registry with optional RBAC HTTP proxy; `mem`, `postgresql`, or `kafkasql` storage.
- `MirrorMaker2` — dedicated-mode MM2 with `ApicurioSchemaTransferSmt` for cross-cluster schema-ID rewrites.
- `KafkaBackup` — CronJob-driven backup to S3/Azure/GCS/PVC; optional schema export.
- `KafkaRestore` — idempotent one-shot restore Job with point-in-time recovery and topic remapping.
- `KafkaBackupValidation` — backup integrity validation.
- `KafkaUI` — Quarkus+htmx web console with OIDC SSO and JWT propagation.
- `KafkaRebalance` — Strimzi-style Cruise Control rebalance trigger with annotation approval.

## How it differs from Strimzi

- Multi-cluster KRaft quorum (Strimzi: single-cluster only).
- Built-in Kroxylicious proxy with OIDC/JWT RBAC at the wire (Strimzi: no proxy layer).
- Apicurio with a JWT-aware RBAC proxy (Strimzi: manages Apicurio but no access control).
- MM2 with `ApicurioSchemaTransferSmt` that rewrites V3 envelope global IDs (Strimzi MM2: no schema envelope handling).
- First-class backup/restore with PITR (Strimzi: no first-party backup).
- Cruise Control bundled (Strimzi: also bundled — comparable here).
- Kafka UI bundled (Strimzi: not provided).

## Architecture

- Three or more Kind/EKS/GKE/AKS clusters joined via any MCS-compatible mesh — Submariner Lighthouse, Cilium Cluster Mesh, Istio multi-cluster, or any other implementation that publishes `ServiceImport` and `*.svc.clusterset.local` DNS.
- Brokers stay local to each Kubernetes cluster; controllers form one KRaft quorum across clusters via `*.svc.clusterset.local` (the MCS standard DNS namespace).
- Safe rolling updates gated by ISR + KRaft quorum checks.
- Cross-cluster roll order declared in `spec.clusterRollOrder`.
- mTLS internal; OIDC at the edge.

## Quickstart

```
git clone https://github.com/afshin-yavari/kafka-operator
cd kafka-operator
make mcs-setup    # 3 Kind clusters + MCS mesh + operator + sample CRs
make quorum       # verify multi-cluster KRaft quorum
make -C kind e2e  # smoke e2e
```

## On the roadmap

Four headline features in active design (no shipped dates yet — design partners shape priority):

- **Live migration from any Kafka cluster** — adopt brokers and controllers one at a time from a self-managed cluster, Strimzi, AWS MSK, or Confluent Cloud, with no downtime. Uses the Kafka 3.9+ AddVoter/RemoveVoter APIs.
- **Tiered storage with Apache Iceberg** — offload cold log segments to S3/Azure/GCS via Aiven's tiered storage plugin; the cold tier is queryable as an Iceberg table by DuckDB, Trino, Spark.
- **Unified audit logging** — cross-cutting audit stream emitted by the Kroxylicious proxy and the Apicurio RBAC proxy. Captures principal (full JWT claim trail), operation, resource, decision, latency. Sinks to a Kafka topic, Loki, or OpenSearch.
- **Visual designer** — modern React + Electron app for designing Kafka Streams topologies on a canvas, browsing topics with type-aware decoding, and authoring schemas. Standalone desktop + embeddable SPA. Pairs with the existing read-mostly KafkaUI.

## License

Apache 2.0. Operator, Kroxylicious filters, Apicurio RBAC proxy, MM2 schema-transfer SMT, backup wrapper, and Kafka UI are all in one repo, all Apache 2.0.
